high_level_description: The image is a meme that humorously compares the act of leaving a Zoom call to the disappearance of a massive star. The top part of the image contains a tweet from Gizmodo, dated June 30, 2020. The tweet reads: "A massive star has disappeared without a trace" followed by a link (bit.ly/3dLzODd). Below the tweet is an image of a bright, glowing star surrounded by a nebula-like cloud, set against a dark blue background filled with stars. The meme uses the tweet as a playful analogy for the sudden and unexpected end of a Zoom call.
